name: oc-ad-bye-pass
description: YouTube 전용 광고 차단 확장 (MV3) — Chrome · Safari

scripts.build:all: npm run build && npm run build:safari
scripts.test:all: npm run check && npm test && npm run test:e2e
scripts.zip: npm run build && cd dist && zip -qr ../oc-ad-bye-pass.zip . && cd .. && echo 'oc-ad-bye-pass.zip'
scripts.zip:safari: npm run build:safari && cd dist-safari && zip -qr ../oc-ad-bye-pass-safari.zip . && cd .. && echo 'oc-ad-bye-pass-safari.zip'
scripts.safari:xcode: npm run build:safari && xcrun safari-web-extension-converter dist-safari --project-location safari --app-name "OC Ad Bye-Pass" --bundle-identifier com.jshsakura.ocadbyepass --swift --no-open --force
